thread:
sarah: Quick heads-up — starting the v2 rollout to eu-west in the midnight window (00:30 UTC). Plan: 10% for 15m, 50% for 30m, then 100% if metrics are green. Deploybot scheduled the job. Please watch client pins and mobile SDKs.

deploybot: Scheduled v2-rollout-eu-west at 00:30 UTC. Job id: jb-2026-05-03-003. Auto-rollback: disabled by default. To pause: `/deploy pause jb-2026-05-03-003`

kyle: @sarah are we holding any client pins for this run (mobile/native)?

sarah: Yes — mobile SDKs with header-case sensitivity are on the hold list. We'll gate mobile at 10% until the SDK patch lands. List: tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma, tenant-mobile-beta.

tina: Updated release notes draft in the docs repo: added section about header normalization and recommended client update. Also flagged schema version bump (response.meta.api_version -> required).

josh: Rollback procedure check — how do ops trigger fallback to v1? Need exact command and who has perms.

sarah: Ops can trigger immediate fallback with the operator CLI:```bash
operator route set-backend --route /v2 --backend v1 --weight 100 --reason "emergency-fallback"
```Only people in the `releases` and `oncall` groups can run that. If deploybot detects error-rate > 3% for 5m it will notify but not auto-rollback. We'll be manual for this window.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert (eu-west): p95 latency increased from 820ms -> 1.2s at 00:42 UTC. Error rate on text.generate up 1.8% (baseline 0.3%).

sarah: Ok pausing the rollout at 30% for investigation. @deploybot please pause the job and stop ramp.

deploybot: Paused job jb-2026-05-03-003 at 5134567910 by sarah. Current rollout: 30% traffic to v2.

kyle: Copy. I'll triage client traces and check the header normalization path on the v2 gateway.

tina: I'll update the release notes with a 'paused' status and add notes for CS.

release-coordinator: I'll ping the top-10 customers in the scheduled notice list and add a short FAQ about why mobile is held.

josh: If we need rollback, recommend we do a partial fallback for mobile-only routes first, not full global rollback. Command to do mobile-only:```bash
operator route set-backend --route /v2/mobile --backend v1 --weight 100 --reason "mobile-fallback"
```

sarah: Agreed. For now we investigate traces and metrics. If latency/error trends worsen within 15m we will execute the mobile fallback command. Please annotate findings in the job run: jb-2026-05-03-003 -> notes. :eyes: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Next check in 5m — will post updated p95 and error-rate.

kyle: Found a repro on a corner case header (x-client-meta) where v2 stricter parsing drops a token causing downstream decode retries. Patch incoming from eng-runtime, ETA 40m.

sarah: Great — once patch is in, we'll resume ramp from 30% and run a short 15m verification window before 50%. Leaving this thread open for logs.

deploybot: Job jb-2026-05-03-003 remains paused. To resume: `/deploy resume jb-2026-05-03-003` — will require a release lead ack.

release-coordinator: Marking release notes as "paused" and sending updated customer notice draft in #marketing for review.

josh: Logging rollback commands in the runbook and adding a quick checklist for on-call.

sarah: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in 10m with telemetry updates.
